body.description: weathered red barn covered in vines with solar panels on the roof, post-apocalyptic solarpunk, classic JRPG overworld building in 3/4 top-down view: you look down from above and see the angled rooftop on the top half and the flat front wall on the bottom half, footprint sits flat on the ground tiles, both side walls completely hidden, perfectly symmetric, like a house in Pokemon HeartGold or RPG Maker, NOT isometric, NO side walls visible, NO two-sided corner, pixel art, transparent background
